import zipfile
from xml.dom import minidom

with zipfile.ZipFile("quarterly_report.docx") as z:
    xml = z.read("word/document.xml")

dom = minidom.parseString(xml)
count = 0
underlined_heads = []
for p in dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p"):
    parts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t"):
        if t.firstChild:
            parts.append(t.firstChild.data)
    text = "".join(parts).strip()
    if not text:
        continue
    if any(c.isupper() for c in text) and not any(c.islower() for c in text):
        u_count = 0
        for r in p.getElementsByTagName("w:r"):
            rPrs = r.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")
            if rPrs and rPrs[0].getElementsByTagName("w:u"):
                u_count += 1
        count += 1
        underlined_heads.append((text, u_count))

for head, u in underlined_heads:
    print(f"{'OK' if u else 'MISSING'} ({u} runs) - {head}")
print("Total headline paragraphs checked:", count)
print("All underlined:", all(u > 0 for _, u in underlined_heads))
